job.title: Supply Chain Graduate
job.description:
Supply Planning & Forecasting 
 You will support our planning team in improving forecast accuracy and planning efficiency through data-driven analysis and innovative solutions. By leveraging analytics, automation and digital tools, you will help optimise planning processes and contribute to more informed decision-making across the business.
 Process Excellence & Digital Transformation 
 You will analyse existing workflows and identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies and increase operational effectiveness. Together with key stakeholders, you will help drive digital transformation initiatives that enable smarter and more agile ways of working.
 Innovation & Automation 
 We are looking for someone who is curious about new technologies and enjoys challenging the status quo. You will explore and implement innovative solutions, including automation and AI-based approaches, to support the future development of our Operations organisation and create measurable business impact.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Supply Chain success depends on strong collaboration. You will work closely with Planning, Logistics, Customer Service and other business functions to improve information flows, strengthen alignment and support seamless end-to-end operations. Bachelor's or Master's degree
 Proven excellence in your academic life
 Relevant work or internship experience is a plus
 A history of pursuing personal passions, extra-curricular achievements
 Entrepreneurial spirit with a "go-getter" mentality when it comes to tackling important projects or taking on new challenges
 Open and solution-oriented mindset, with excellent communication skills
 Fluent in German or French (written, spoken), additional languages are considered a plus We offer an intense, challenging 18-month deep-dive into the business and a real job where you can make an impact from day 1. Furthermore, a job rotation within a function that has a close link to your role and an intensive Graduate Training Week is included as well.
 Got what it takes? In your application we want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.
 
 As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and utilizing opportunities. The job advertisement is aimed at all people equally, regardless of age, skin color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or origin.
